title: Facet Column Sort Configuration
description: For a column model whose facet type is enumeration, defines the order in which the facet values are returned. If not specified, the default order is frequency, descending with a secondary sort by value ascending.

property.description: Which property of a facet to use for sorting, can be by value frequency or the facet value itself.
property.name: FacetColumnSortProperty

enum.name: FREQUENCY
enum.description: (Default) Sort by the frequency of a facet value. A secondary sort by value, ascending is always added for consistency.

enum.name: VALUE
enum.description: Sort by the natural order of the facet value.
